user_story:
As a user, I want to log into the application using my credentials so that I can access the secure area. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. Given I am on the login page at 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login', when I enter 'tomsmith' in the input with id 'username' and 'SuperSecretPassword!' in the input with id 'password', and click the button with text 'Login', I should be redirected to the secure area. 
2. If I enter incorrect credentials, I should remain on the login page and not be redirected. 
3. The flash messages should be displayed in the div with id 'flash-messages'.
